Against IDH-mutant status, the lesion has substantial necrotic/non-enhancing core and enhancing tumor burden by Proportion Necrosis, NCR Volume (mL), ET Volume (mL), and Proportion Enhancing, plus aggressive spread/mass-effect features including Total tumor volume (mL), midline_shift_present, Ependymal (ventricular) Invasion, Multiple satellites present, Deep WM invasion, and CET Crosses midline, which are more often seen in IDH-wildtype glioblastoma. Overall, the T2-FLAIR mismatch and young frontal presentation outweigh the aggressive features for molecular IDH prediction, so the best estimate is IDH-mutant.

overall_comment: Predictions are based only on structured MRI metadata without diffusion, perfusion, spectroscopy, susceptibility/calcification assessment, or histopathology. The marked T2-FLAIR mismatch drives the IDH-mutant and 1p/19q non-codeleted calls, while the necrotic enhancing mass with edema, midline crossing, ventricular invasion, satellites, and mass effect drives the CNS WHO grade 4 imaging estimate.
